text: Testing plays a crucial role in software development. Unit tests check individual components, like a single function or method, to ensure they work correctly in isolation. Integration tests go further, verifying that different modules or services interact smoothly together. A popular approach is test-driven development (TDD), where developers write tests before writing the code itself. This forces them to think about requirements upfront and makes debugging easier. While initial time investment is needed, testing builds confidence. When a bug is found or a new feature is added, you can run existing tests quickly. This reduces the fear of breaking something and allows developers to make changes more freely.
